name: American Tire and Motorsports
old_description: Our continued commitment to service, quality and product innovation have established Rampage Products as a significant leader of premium parts and accessories in the specialty Jeep, Truck, SUV and UTV marketplace. Our team of industry enthusiasts not only use our products, but also contribute to the many new ideas and product innovations you can see today on our website and in our catalog. Together we invite you to review our program; use our products; and join our growing family of satisfied customers.
about:
American Tire and Motorsports operates from a single facility at 689 McLean Avenue in Yonkers, New York. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed on its website.

The business functions as a retail and installation center for aftermarket automotive parts and accessories, focusing on pickup trucks, SUVs, Jeeps, and UTVs. Its service offerings include custom fabrication projects and interior/exterior coating applications, notably DINITROL rust proofing. The shop stocks and installs products from brands such as Rampage Products, Buyers Products Company, ZROADZ Off Road Products, RIGID Industries, Westin Automotive, Artec Industries, and Energy Suspension. Product categories span automotive lighting, bumpers and grille guards, cargo management, suspension systems, towing accessories, truck bed covers, wheels and tires, winches, and bedliners.

The company serves individual vehicle owners and enthusiasts seeking upgrades for off-road and on-road use. Its customer base includes drivers of Chevrolet, Dodge, Ford, GMC, Jeep, Land Rover, Ram, and Toyota vehicles who require professional installation of purchased parts.

American Tire and Motorsports positions itself as a one-stop provider where customers can purchase parts and have them installed on-site, summarized by the slogan "BUY A PART? WE CAN INSTALL IT!" The team describes itself as industry enthusiasts who personally use the products they sell.
